A sequence of functions $M_n : \Omega \to \mathbb R$ is a backwards martingale with respect to $(\mathcal F_n)$ and $\mu$ if $M_0$ is $\mu$-integrable and, for every $n$, $M_n = \mathbb E[M_0 \mid \mathcal F_n]$ $\mu$-almost everywhere.
